# LiftGauge

> The honest training log for lifters who care about the numbers. Log sets in seconds, watch the graph climb, never wonder what you did last Tuesday again.

LiftGauge is a free, web-based gym tracking app (PWA) built for lifters who want a clean, fast logbook without ads, streaks-as-ransom, or social feeds. It works on any modern browser, installs to the home screen on iOS and Android, and syncs across devices.

## What it does

- **Plan** — A template per workout, on fixed weekdays or taking turns in a rotation.
- **Home** — This week at a glance, the next workout one tap away, a weekly streak, and a body map of the muscles trained in the last 30 days.
- **Log a session** — Quick rep buttons (or type your own), a weight stepper, last session's numbers one tap away or filled in for you. Optional rest timer.
- **Exercise library** — 1,400+ illustrated exercises, stored on the phone so they show instantly; add your own.
- **Log Book** — Every saved session, set by set, editable.
- **Stats** — Per-exercise charts for total volume, top set and estimated 1RM, plus a year of training.
- **New here** — A one-minute guided tour on first open.

## Principles

- No ads, ever.
- No dark patterns, no streaks held hostage.
- Your data stays yours — export anytime.
- Works offline (PWA); saves on reconnect.
- Free forever for core tracking.

## Tech

- Web app (PWA) built with React + Vite + TypeScript.
- Firebase for auth and data sync.
- Deployed on Vercel.
